lu_and_piv.description: ``(lu, piv)``, output of :func:`~jax.scipy.linalg.lu_factor`. ``lu`` is an array of shape ``(..., M, N)``, containing ``L`` in its lower triangle and ``U`` in its upper. ``piv`` is an array of shape ``(..., K)``, with ``K = min(M, N)``, which encodes the pivots.

b.description: right-hand-side of linear system. Must have shape ``(..., M)``

trans.description: type of system to solve. Options are:

output.description: Array of shape ``(..., N)`` representing the solution of the linear system.
